        bpy.data.objects.remove(o,do_unlink=True)
# Use smooth working-rope tails; the previous six-point outline made angular corners.
def smooth_chain(points,steps=9):
    p=[Vector(v) for v in points];outp=[]
    for i in range(len(p)-1):
        p0=p[max(0,i-1)];p1=p[i];p2=p[i+1];p3=p[min(len(p)-1,i+2)]
        for j in range(steps):
            t=j/steps
            q=.5*((2*p1)+(-p0+p2)*t+(2*p0-5*p1+4*p2-p3)*t*t+(-p0+3*p1-3*p2+p3)*t*t*t)
            q.z=max(.428,q.z)
            outp.append(q)
    return outp+[p[-1]]
for name in ['Coil loose end','Coil crossed free loop']:
    o=c.objects.get(name)
    if not o or o.get('smooth_tail'):continue
    coords=[v.co.copy() for v in o.data.vertices]
    points=[sum(coords[k:k+8],Vector())/8 for k in range(0,len(coords),8)]
    bpy.data.objects.remove(o,do_unlink=True)
    ob=tube(name,smooth_chain(points),.022,rope,8);ob['smooth_tail']=True
